Cloud infrastructure momentum remains strong and NET is showing sustained price and volume strength.

FICO has strong recent relative performance and remains a liquid large-cap momentum candidate.
Veeva is one of the strongest S&P 500 relative-strength names and offers a liquid healthcare-software trend.
Moderna ranks at the top of current S&P 500 relative-strength screens and offers strong trend acceleration.
AI infrastructure remains a dominant market theme, making Nvidia a core liquid momentum name despite elevated event risk.

JPMorgan is a highly liquid financial leader suitable for relative-strength and sector-rotation setups.
Goldman Sachs offers liquid financial-sector momentum exposure and benefits when risk appetite rotates toward cyclicals.

sector_notes: The market backdrop is mixed: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq ended the prior week lower while energy has been the strongest October sector and basic materials the weakest. Software has recovered strongly from its earlier 2026 selloff, with cybersecurity particularly strong, while AI-related semiconductor names remain sensitive to concerns about debt-funded data-center spending. Oil has recently been elevated by supply disruptions, but crude fell on October 26, easing some immediate inflation pressure; the week is dominated by mega-cap earnings and an expected Federal Reserve decision.
